title: Concept: Package manifest declares an unreadable licence
description: package.json declares a package.json whose `license` field defers to an unreadable or absent grant, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a package.json whose `license` field defers to an unreadable or absent grant.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a package.json whose `license` field defers to an unreadable or absent grant.
